content.text: This gene signature (CDK6, SOX4, PRSS57, TSPAN13/ZFAS1, NPM1, high ribosomal proteins, ANKRD28) is characteristic of immature hematopoietic progenitor cells (HSPCs) rather than a mature PBMC lineage — PRSS57 and TSPAN13 in particular are classic HSPC/early progenitor markers, and CDK6/SOX4/NPM1 reflect a proliferative, undifferentiated state.
